featured_reviews.review_text:
I had contact them in October 2022 for my booking in December 2023. Everything was done, they wrote our contact number and finalized our date, they asked us to make the booking amount next year, next year when we went to taste their food, the lady was little spectical about the date but still she said that she will do it and asked us to come for booking in lent season that just going on. We went to her for the bookings and she didn't even come outside to say no, her husband attended us and said that Quinita their daughter has already taken in the booking for that particular date and especially we cannot take your booking bcoz it's their cousins family wedding only.

I just wanted to say:When we came for the booking on October 2022, the date was free and you asked us to come next year we did, you asked to to come in lent we did and now you are saying that it's booked

This is business I understand but what kind person are those who just keep you waiting for their profit? You should have told us earlier only? Why to keep us waiting?

We very happy by the ways Quinita's parents attended us when we went for the booking, but seeing their this attitude it just upsets us and make us to think that no one should be trusted........

They are good in catering services but when you go for booking just do not go by their words you never know when they will change.....
